title: Ad Verification Demo
subtitle: A simple, tamper-evident advertising record for fictional Cedar Valley Tourism.
metaDescription: Inspect four signed advertising records, simulate a change, and see a local miniature blockchain detect the mismatch. Fictional campaign; real cryptography.
imageAlt: Illustrative mountain landscape for fictional Cedar Valley Tourism
problem: Advertising reports can be altered after a handoff, making record reconciliation difficult.
task: Make record-integrity verification understandable without wallets, tokens, or a technical dashboard.
actions: Built four SHA-256-linked blocks with signed advertising events and three local validator approvals per block.
Added a one-button tamper scenario, original-record restoration, and optional evidence inspection.
Used fictional campaign data and kept signing keys within the browser session.
results: An intact example chain verifies; an edited publisher record fails and flags the dependent next step.
Visitors can inspect calculated hashes and export public proof without exporting private keys.
notes: Unlisted preview at /demos/ad-verification. This metadata is deliberately unpublished, so no public portfolio page is generated. All identities and validators run in one browser: this is not distributed consensus or proof of ad delivery. The hero landscape is extracted from the approved AI concept.
